budget_items.topic: Regional dispatch proposal costs and savings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Costs will rise due to new regulations and added call volume, and the committee said it needs savings data before deciding.
budget_items.quote: ks pointed out costs will increase due to new regulations and added call volume

budget_items.topic: Hurricane Irene storm expenditures and reimbursement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town spent $12.6K on the storm, mostly staff overtime, and expects 75% of expenditures to be reimbursed under the state of emergency.
budget_items.quote: spent $12.6k for the storm, primarily for overtime for staff called in

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 12.5% reimbursement is in the governor's budget, worth $120K, and must still pass the House and Senate.
budget_items.quote: 12.5% reimbursement is back in governor's budget ($120k)

budget_items.topic: Mass Avenue gas station abandoned property tanks
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Clean Harbor is to pump and dispose of fuel in the tanks at a cost of $5K, and KS will ask to pay for it from the reserve.
budget_items.quote: clean harbor scheduled tomorrow to pump and dispose of gas in tanks at a cost of $5k

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The annual cost of this insurance has risen from $25K to $75K because of the town's losses, and few companies carry this coverage.
budget_items.quote: cost has increased from $25k to $75k annually due to our losses

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A change order of $26K adds load-bearing walls missed on the plan, paid from the established project contingency funds; the doors out for rebid are expected to cost less.
budget_items.quote: requires change order of $26k to add some load- bearing walls; money will come out of established project contingency fund

budget_items.topic: Summer Street project grant design costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Senator Flanagan committed to an amendment to have 20% design costs included in the grant plan.
budget_items.quote: senator flanagan committed to make amendment to have 20% design costs in grant plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: JM requested an updated projection of debt service levels.
budget_items.quote: jm requested updated projection on debt service levels
